question: Pankaj Advani won his 25th World Title in October 2022 at
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuala Lumpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pankaj Advani won his 25th World Title in October 2022 at the **World Billiards Championship** held in Kuala Lumpur.
 
• He is one of the most celebrated cueists in the world, holding multiple world titles in both snooker and billiards.
 
• In this championship, Advani secured the title by defeating his competitor with exceptional skill and strategic play.
 
• This victory further cemented his status as a dominant figure in the world of cue sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Billiards and Snooker:**

 
 
• Billiards and snooker are cue sports played on a rectangular table covered with a cloth, with pockets at each of the four corners and in the middle of each of the long side cushions.
 
• Both games require players to strike a white cue ball to pot other balls in a specific sequence.
 
 
 
• **Pankaj Advani's Achievements:**
 
 
• Pankaj Advani has won numerous world titles in both billiards and snooker, making him one of the most successful cueists in history.
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, for his contributions to sports.
 
 
 
• **World Billiards Championship:**
 
 
• The World Billiards Championship is an annual event where the best billiards players from around the world compete for the title.
 
• It is governed by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association (WPBSA).
 
 
 
• **Cue Sports Popularity in India:**
 
 
• Cue sports have gained considerable popularity in India, with many young players taking up the sport.
 
• India has produced several world-class players, with Pankaj Advani being the most prominent.
